# Cloudy Sky · Inline Metal Shader
A blue sky and a drifting cloud bank under a warm sun. The shader generates its own smooth 3D noise because Metal Render has no texture channels. It marches only through the cloud layer, reduces fine detail in the distance, and composites shaded cloud samples with atmospheric haze. The shader is embedded in the Text node. JSON State advances time by 1/30 second per Loop call; Loop is capped at 30 Hz. Width and Height control full-screen preview and saved output.
